plain_what: When a model reads memory and then writes an answer, the learning signal should reach the actual geometric objects that carried the information, not just the final scoring coefficients. This line pushes error credit back through the live H4 carriers and prototypes, and later through one shared token-vector table used for input, memory and output.
how_it_works: Two forms. (1) September #973 addressed attention: sample four hard trajectories (read, key, emit decisions), then credit each parameter-score event with the normalized suffix cost-to-go from its CE boundary instead of the whole-trajectory loss, using the other particles as baseline. (2) October M2 form: the saved437 native field scores factual-state and local-state H4 relations against Generate prototypes; freezing those carriers while fitting only the coefficients disconnects the geometry from what must generalize. The unified credit computes independent conditional utilities over all 120 H4 elements, restores the exact saved fractional masters (quarter-grid Q4 codes q/4, q in [-7,7]), and fits Context carriers, prototypes and coefficients together on the pooled-ranking plus EOS objective. Factor reads are factored onto at most 120 encountered prototypes per lane. Whole-path design extends credit to compiler spans, exact store writes, E8 root admission and consumed donors through an explicit hard-decision graph, with exact token, occurrence and version identity kept apart from the geometric summaries. The float shared writer ties one learned vector table to token input, addressed output and the compiler/store/emitter channel, with product-cell addressing and omitted-target score credit. The integer form of this shared carrier now lives in discrete-learning.
geometry: H4 / 600-cell relative element codes (120 icosian elements, Q4 quantized), SpiralCore E8 actions and 240 E8 roots as coarse routes, exact prime-addressed occurrence store (identity kept separate), product cells from first/last 8D block roots, quarter-grid Z[phi]-style finite signed tables.

status_reason: Executed forms failed or broke a rule: three fixed 128-update arms went from 437/512 to 0/512 (docs/labs/unified-geometric-integration-2026-10-11), September pilots failed (docs/native_geometric_addressed_attention_causal_pilot_973.md), and the sampled-choice producer uses softmax (D23). reopen_conditions: A D23-compliant replacement for the sampled-choice producer, such as exact hard selection by address or integer counterfactual moves, with the credit path scanned end to end

One coherent typed binding, frame and native credit boundary qualified first, as the whole-path audit requires, so carriers and prototypes change under a readout that is trained with them rather than frozen

A panel that is not component-only (the saved panel reuses 128 banks, 12 query strings and 48 exact answers for 512 inputs) with at least 2 seeds and a genuinely fresh qualification draw of at least 128 rows
Matched ON versus OFF credit with identical active parameters, all 4,096 Generate choices and physical Copy aliases scored, carriers rebuilt after each update
An offline float re-registration under D37 (fresh FIT, owner release, separately scanned module, export gap against the D11 integer form), or an integer counterfactual form on the discrete path
Owner release of the separate M2 training and rental hold

rule_compat.D11: M2 stack serves from finite signed geometric tables (Q4 codes), so the served form is integer. Float masters are training-only and the export gap of the unified form was never measured. Every position still scores all 4,096 Generate choices, so per-token parameter access is not sparse (D5-b unmeasured).
rule_compat.D23: Blocked: the delivered whole-path sampled-choice law (#2246 producer) uses softmax and the pooled-rank loss used softplus. The shared-writer margin form and the integer discrete writer are compliant.
rule_compat.D30: The finite-factor path uses table reads and quarter-grid sums, not matmul. The shared writer scans bounded cell sets with L1 displacement. D29 module scans passed for the writer (31 controls).
rule_compat.D32_D37: Pre-D32 float form is preserved inactive under D32. D37 makes it re-registrable as an offline float sheet; the integer carrier (one table for input, carry, output) is already ACTIVE in the discrete crate.
